comments.text: The sheer variety of Iran's landscapes is utterly mind-blowing! Seeing those snow-capped peaks rising directly behind the sprawling cities and desert valleys is pure magic. What an absolute treasure of untouched natural beauty!

comments.author: @russ320
comments.text: I was in Iran October 2025. As one of a few Americans that have been I will say it was one of my favorite countries out of the 68 I have visited. Very nice people, welcomed me and kind from the military to the police to the citizens, safe ,very smart and outstanding history. I plan to go back in September or October 2026. My same guide was excellent in English and Spanish. Very intelligent and safe.
